problem: Given a data set with $15$ data points and ${\sum }_{i=1}^{15}{x}_{i}=91,$ compute $\overset{―}{x}.$ Round your answer to one decimal place.
worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n},$ then the mean is denoted by $\overset{―}{x}$ and is given by the following formula:

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}
$$

Substituting $n=15$ and ${\sum }_{i=1}^{15}{x}_{i}=91,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{15}\cdot 91≈6.1,\end{aligned}
$$

where we have rounded our answer to one decimal place.
